content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to establish communication with a [product_name] module, but facing difficulties. I understand this module has limited capability and is only set up as a server for 'S7 Communication'. However, I'm unable to either successfully enter a TSAP address in [product_name] or create an S7 connection within it using [product_name] software, version [version_no]. When trying, I cannot specify the local interface, so it's not possible to get a TSAP address. Selecting the interface results in an error stating 'no connection resources available', even though resources are allocated. Is there a standard TSAP address for communication on this module, or does it strictly require an S7 connection to be created (which seems impossible)? Has anyone managed to set up communication between a [product_name] Lean and [product_name] before?

Have you seen this [company_name] website: Application examples for [product_name]? There is an example covering communication with a [product_name] ([version_no]). Although somewhat dated, it details how [version_no] (or similar modules) can communicate with [product_name] ([article_no]), which should guide you in setting up your connection.
